## Upstream Open-Source Track Record

- **Apple mlx-swift** (Merged PR #467): Fixed convolution padding bounds calculation in Metal GPU kernels on Apple Silicon.
- **Apple swift-argument-parser** (Merged PR #961): Solved CLI flag parsing edge case with attached values in Swift command-line tools.
- **Apple swift-protobuf** (Merged PR #2159): Implemented deterministic ordering in TextFormat serialization for reproducible unit testing.
- **Apple swift-openapi-runtime** (Merged PR #214): Added validating mutating setters to dynamic OpenAPI value containers.
- **Google osv-scanner** (Merged PR #3049): Preserved vulnerability report HTML filter state during multi-page rendering.
- **Fastlane** (Merged PR #30169): Maintained application-identifier prefix integrity during iOS signing workflows.
- **Tuist Toolchain** (Merged PR #15500, Active PRs #15568 & #15566): Handled empty warning headers & simctl JSON parsing; hardened simulator boot lifecycle.
- **Point-Free swift-snapshot-testing** (Active PR #1136): Enabled Swift Testing snapshot attachment recording via CLI.
- **Kingfisher** (Active PRs #2618, #2617, #2616, #2614): Propagated cancellation on linked tasks, prefetcher cache file extension forwarding, and DocC documentation fixes.
